description: Keep nursery essentials close at hand with the Mackenzie Nightstand. This solid hardwood nightstand features a single smooth-gliding drawer for storing pacifiers, burp cloths, and other small items, plus an open shelf for books or a lamp. The warm Brown Maple finish and clean design coordinate perfectly with the full Mackenzie collection. Compact enough to fit beside a glider or crib, this versatile piece transitions easily into any room as your child grows.
